reply_text:
*I’d fix two things before shipping*, especially the dataset naming bug.

*1. High — dataset names are truncated, and separate files can silently merge.*
`ingest/jobs.py:6` — `rstrip('.csv')` removes any trailing characters in the set `.csv`, not the exact suffix.
• All four documented datasets are misnamed: `events.csv` → `event`, `sessions.csv` → `session`, `invoices.csv` → `invoice`, `refunds.csv` → `refund`.
• I reproduced `metric.csv` and `metrics.csv` both loading into the same `metri` dataset.

Use exact suffix removal (`removesuffix('.csv')` or `splitext`) and add tests for the documented names and a two-file collision case. The current test’s `payouts_2026.csv` happens to avoid this bug.

*2. Medium — half-even rounding depends on the caller’s Decimal context.*
`ingest/money.py:7` — `quantize(CENT)` inherits the active rounding mode rather than enforcing the finance rule.
• Under the default context, `2.345` becomes `2.34`.
• With `ROUND_HALF_UP` active, the same call returns `2.35`, violating `docs/finance-rules.md`.

Pass `rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN` explicitly and test inside a non-half-even `localcontext()`.

*Validation:* All 4 existing tests pass. I also verified BOM-prefixed CSVs with quoted multiline cells load correctly. Reviewed `main` (`f44c88c`) through branch head `27d16b8`; no files changed.
